review.instruction: Verify every user journey in the mission goal has exactly one flow with an actor and valid entry route, and no extra flow substitutes for a missing journey.
Verify every case states precondition, input, ordered UI actions within the declared step budget, observable assertions, expected result and verification. Cases are written before execution.

Verify access, fixtures and source roles are frozen per flow; authenticated flows use distinct account aliases, seeded flows use distinct namespaces, and anonymous or fixture-free flows explicitly carry none. No secret value appears.

Verify every flow has one unit with the same id, journey goal and tier. Journey tiers correspond to mission paths; secondary tiers have one concrete reason; prior unchecked flows are covered or explicitly extended.

failurePolicy: Record the exact missing journey, invalid entry, unexecutable action/assertion, shared prerequisite or tier mismatch. Revise only affected flows and reassess all journeys; never walk a flow during planning.
